frame.grid.note: recorded for provenance/auditing ONLY. This digest is NEVER a gate predicate: llvmpipe is not bit-reproducible and this scenario's own sweep produced 10 DISTINCT grid digests over 10 BYTE-IDENTICAL dumps. Byte-hashing the frame would make the gate flake on renderer noise. The dump is hashed byte-wise because it is quantised and deterministic; the frame is compared with a measured tolerance. The asymmetry is deliberate.

determinism_findings.fourth_traffic_source: THE FINDING THIS SCENARIO PAID FOR. The first 10-run sweep gave FOUR distinct dump digests: 5 runs dumped a two-entity world, 3 dumped a three-entity world carrying {id: Mining Transporter, role: miner}, and 2 REFUSED with 'Cobra Mark I=254.8750' still under thrust. The cause is NOT engine nondeterminism: this save's system contains a ROCK HERMIT, whose rockHermitAI.plist CHECK_FOR_ROCKS state calls launchMiner on a 20 s pauseAI cycle (StationEntity.m:1736-1776). NONE of scenario 015's three suppressions touch it - hasNPCTraffic gates the ordinary trader schedule, not a station's own AI - because 015's save is docked at Lave's main station and never meets a hermit. Fix: suppress_station_ai() writes oolite-nullAI.js to every station and VERIFIES the read-back (the engine reports the RESOLVED name 'nullAI.plist', so both names are pinned and a silently-ignored setAI cannot pass).
determinism_findings.probe_ordering: A SECOND, INDEPENDENT CAUSE, AND THE SAME SHAPE SCENARIO 010 MEASURED. Even with the AI silenced a sweep still gave four digests, because the census and mission-variable probes - about fourteen console round trips, several seconds - ran BEFORE the suppressions. Whatever runs before the suppression is a window the station launches into. Moving every probe AFTER the four suppressions took the sweep to 10/10 byte-identical; a 30 s watch with repeated clearing then saw no miner at all.
determinism_findings.reading: Both were design defects in THIS HARNESS, not flakiness in the engine, and both were found by reading the dumps that differed rather than by widening a tolerance or a round count. A 2-in-10 or 4-in-10 disagreement in a NEW gate is almost always an observable the scenario does not control yet (beads oo-rkm, oo-qwk5).

margin.reading: the floor sits 12.3x above the largest same-scene noise and at 0.39x of the dimmest real frame measured, so no same-scene variation can push a real frame under it and an empty render cannot climb over it.

frame_liveness.what_it_proves: that something was RENDERED. A run that died before drawing, or drew into a lost context, yields an all-black grid at distance 0.

discrimination_limit.reading: STATED RATHER THAN IMPLIED. The frame assertion does NOT discriminate every world difference: frames from the pre-fix sweep that carried an extra Mining Transporter entity sit at 0.31x..0.36x tolerance, INSIDE the same-scene band, because that ship is far off camera. So the frame proves the RENDER is the blessed render; the DUMP, not the frame, carries this scenario's world-state claim. Bead oo-gxp's scenario 010 reached a 261-fold separation for a change that was ON SCREEN; a change off screen has none, and implying otherwise would be the vacuous half of a two-artifact gate.

frame_tolerance.tolerance_source: tests/golden/frame_hash.py derive_tolerance() over tests/golden/calibration.json (bead oo-ae9). USED AS MEASURED, never adjusted to make a run pass.
frame_tolerance.why_asserted: MEASURED AND ACCEPTED, unlike scenario 015. All 45 same-scene pairs across the 10-run sweep sit at 0.31x..0.37x the measured tolerance - a 2.7x margin - because this scene carries no animated HUD population (scenario 015's live trumbles WERE the picture, giving it 1.08x..2.49x and forcing asserted=false with a reason). A black render is 11.85x the tolerance away and a white one 216x, so the assertion has teeth against a dead or broken render.

stability.note: 10 of 10 runs wrote a BYTE-IDENTICAL dump (2893 bytes, one digest), 0 refused, 0 errored - dumped + refused + errored == runs, so every run is accounted for. TWO EARLIER SWEEPS WERE NOT STABLE and the reason is recorded under determinism_findings below, because the fix was a real finding about this system, not a retune.
